name: JINZAI Street Props / 津仔的街道设施
description:
JINZAI Street Props is a Minecraft 1.20.1 decorative expansion for Fabric and Forge. It adds street-light heads, branches and poles, road signs and sign poles, and bus-stop signs for city construction. It can be used alongside JINZAI Traffic Lights and MTR.

津仔的街道设施是适用于 Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric 与 Forge 的城市装饰模组，加入路灯头、路灯分支、路灯杆、路牌、路牌杆与公交站牌，可与津仔的交通灯及 MTR 一同使用。

Art and funding / 美术与资金支持: Crzay津仔. Technical implementation / 技术实现与制作: QiZhang. Art asset copyright belongs to Crzay津仔; mod code/config copyright belongs to QiZhang.
